# seis-tiempo (ORM, docs/SEIS_BLOQUES_11_20.md, PLAN_100 F14, box 6 of block 11. Templo del Tiempo de adulto):
# one game and five bots. A warps into Market_Adult (Market_Entrance, adult) and walks its key rooms with
# place (recorridos_adulto.py's); the bots (seis-tiempo.bots.txt) come in from HyruleField_Adult after it
# and follow it 3 m off. In the first room A falls and bots 3 and 4 lift it; then bot5 sends a room's flag
# (A's game takes it 0 -> 1) and bot1 goes down, bot2 lifts it.
# The change of era: bot4 turns child (the sword back in the pedestal), then adult.
# Generated by tools/harness/seis_adulto.py: edit its tables, not this file. Run (orm/rama-unica's harness):
#   python -I tools/orm/harness/r03_pareja.py --scenario seis-tiempo --scen-dir tools/orm/harness/escenarios
# 1 game, 5 bots, puppets and min-fps 25 come from the name (seis-*); transport and bot-arg are in the .bots.txt.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves entrada-adulto-tiempo
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_OBJECTS=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_BOSS=1,LICHII_COOP_STORY=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt,LICHII_COOP_DOWNED=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_LIFE=1
#! timeout 446
#! expect A coop: test warp done
#! never A coop: test goto timed out
#! never A coop: test place .*: failed
#! never A coop: test warp to .* did not happen
#! never A coop: server refused
#! count A coop: player \d+ 'bot\d' joined >= 5 within boot..
#! never A coop: puppet: P\d+ CoopPuppet_\w+ not spawned after
#! expect A coop: downed: P\d is down \(PLAYER_STATUS dead\)
#! expect A coop: downed: P\d is up again
#! never A group defeat: GROUP_DEFEAT
#! never A -> game_over
#! never A coop: boss: Link's actor (is gone|not found)
#! expect A coop: lists: .*shared_dungeon_adult\.txt: \d+ flags and keys added within boot..
#! count A coop: puppet: P\d+ CoopPuppet_Adult spawned >= 5
#! expect A coop: downed: alive -> downed within caida..levantado
#! expect A downed -> reviving: revive requested by P\d within caida..levantado
#! expect A reviving -> alive: revived \(by P\d within caida..levantado
#! expect A coop: test place 84\.80 104\.20 \-34\.00: done within r01-nave..caida
#! expect A coop: test place 106\.00 104\.90 \-34\.00: done within r02-puerta..r03-pedestal
#! expect A coop: test place 133\.50 104\.90 \-34\.00: done within r03-pedestal..r04-despertar
#! expect A coop: test place 120\.50 105\.70 \-26\.70: done within r04-despertar..fin
#! expect A coop: flags debug: \w+ 0x727c2cbd \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within caida..fin
#! never A coop: flags debug: \w+ 0x727c2cbd \(entry \d+\) 1 -> 0
#! expect A coop: puppet: P\d+ CoopPuppet_Child spawned within caida..fin
mark start
warp Market_Adult Market_Entrance adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark llegada
wait 1200               # the five bots follow A into Market_Adult
mark r01-nave           # the Temple of Time's nave (where the Prelude of Light lands)
place 84.80 104.20 -34.00
wait 300
mark caida              # A falls here: bots 3 and 4 come and hold A beside it
life 0
wait 2400               # their 3.5 s and the game's 6 s revive
mark levantado          # then bot5 sends the flag and bot1 goes down, bot2 lifts it
wait 600
mark r02-puerta         # the Door of Time and the three stones
place 106.00 104.90 -34.00
wait 300
wait 900
mark r03-pedestal       # the Master Sword's pedestal
place 133.50 104.90 -34.00
wait 300
wait 900
mark r04-despertar      # where the adult Link wakes
place 120.50 105.70 -26.70
wait 300
wait 900
mark fin
